To get the best out of your Chilly’s products, it’s less about extra gadgets and more about how you use them:

Use pre-chilled water and ice for bottles to max out cold performance.
Hand wash with hot soapy water; for deeper cleaning use bicarbonate soda/baking powder and a bottle brush.
Store without the cap on when not in use so the inside can fully dry.
For hot drinks (Series 2/3 Bottles, Coffee Cups, Switch in cup mode), avoid filling above 90°C (194°F) and be careful as drinks stay hot for hours.

Follow these and your bottle or cup will pretty much be performing at its best straight out of the box.

If it doesn't work out for me, what are my options?
If things don’t work out, you’ve got a few options:
Cancel a regular order: You have up to 15 minutes after the order confirmation email to cancel via the email or your Chilly’s account. After that, it’s usually already processed.
Return your order: You can return unused items within 30 days of delivery (no free returns). UK returns go through the online portal; non‑UK returns go to our Bedford warehouse address.
Engraved items: These can’t be returned for a refund unless they’re damaged or faulty.
Gift cards: If you need to cancel a gift card, our team can void the card for you since normal 15‑minute cancellation doesn’t apply.
Warranty: All products have a 2‑year warranty against manufacturing defects. If you bought from a third‑party retailer, returns normally go through them first (except Boots purchases, which come to us).
